title: SAMformer: Unlocking the Potential of Transformers in Time Series Forecasting with Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Channel-Wise Attention
training_protocol: Pinned official implementation and claim command; see native claim catalog.
evaluation_protocol: Paper-native chronological holdout and paper-native metrics.

evidence_spans.quote:
SAMformer primary-source excerpts curated from the ICML 2024 paper.

Datasets. Exchange contains the time series of daily exchange rates between 8 countries from 1990 to 2016. All time series are segmented with input length L = 512, prediction horizons H in {96, 192, 336, 720}, and a stride of 1.

Table 1 reports average test MSE with standard deviation obtained on 5 runs with different seeds.
Exchange
96 0.161±0.007

Table 6 reports average test MAE with standard deviation obtained on 5 runs with different seeds.
Exchange
96 0.306±0.006

Training parameters. For all experiments, SAMformer is trained with Adam, batch size 32, a cosine annealing scheduler, and Exchange learning rate 0.001. The training/validation/test split is 70%/20%/10% on Exchange. We use a look-back window L = 512 and a sliding window with stride 1. The training loss is MSE. Training is performed during 300 epochs and we use early stopping with a patience of 5 epochs. Each experiment is run 5 times with different seeds, and the average and standard deviation of test MSE and MAE are reported.

Table 4 gives rho = 0.7 for SAMformer on Exchange at horizon 96.
evidence_spans.source_revision: ICML 2024 paper, Table 1 and Table 6, SAMformer, Exchange, horizon 96

            elif [ "$data" = "traffic" ]; then
                learning_rate=0.0001
                n_block=8
                dropout=0.7
                ff_dim=64
            elif [ "$data" = "exchange_rate" ]; then
                learning_rate=0.001
                n_block=8
                dropout=0.7
                ff_dim=64
            elif [ "$data" = "toy" ]; then
                learning_rate=0.001
                n_block=2
                dropout=0.9
                ff_dim=64
            else
                echo "Unknown dataset: $data"
                continue
            fi
            
            # Construct the command with the appropriate parameters
            command="python run.py --model $model --data $data --seq_len $seq_len --pred_len $pred_len --learning_rate $learning_rate --n_block $n_block --dropout $dropout --ff_dim $ff_dim --num_heads 1 --d_model 16 --rho $rho ${use_sam_flag} ${add_results_flag}"
            
            echo "Executing: $command"
            eval $command
        done
    done
done
